messages.subject: Latent Regression Model
parts:
Dear Phil,

I would like to estimate a constraint latent regression model (in the picture enclosed) using the mirt command. Unfortunately I don't know what is the syntax for this model using the mirt command.

Below is my syntax using mirt command for a symetrical bifactor model. Latent regression model equations in structural equation modeling are also enclosed.

Could you help me with the syntax for this model please ?

Many thanks in advance.


spec<-'

G = 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,10,11,12,13,14,15

F1 = 1,2,3,4,5
F2 = 6,7,8
F3 = 9,10,11
F4 = 12,13,14,15'

mod.md<- mirt(ddd, model=spec, itemtype='graded', SE = TRUE)
mod.md
extract.mirt(mod.md, what='time')
coef(mod.md, simplify=TRUE)
coef(mod.md, printSE=TRUE)
fscores(mod.md, method='EAP', full.scores=T, full.scores.SE = TRUE)
